register.labelZh: BE OFF 片語動詞的實際用途
register.labelEn: BE OFF Phrasal Verbs in Use
register.summaryZh: I must be off 和 We had better be off 都是表示是時候離開的自然說法。；How are we off for time? 和 How are we off for coffee? 可以用來詢問還有多少時間或物資。；你可以用 off coffee、off sweets 或 off some medicine,表示某人暫時不喝、不吃或不再服用某物。；be off your food 是一個實用的英式表達,表示某人不想吃東西或沒有胃口。
register.summaryEn: Expressions such as I must be off and We had better be off are natural ways to say that it is time to leave. How are we off for time? and How are we off for coffee? help you check how much is available. You can say that someone is off coffee, off sweets or off some medicine. Be off your food is a useful British expression for saying that someone does not feel like eating.
